params.caption: 🎮 GTA+ now covers GTA 6: $8 a month for perks in Vice City Rockstar is expanding its GTA+ subscription beyond GTA Online to include GTA 6. For $8 a month, members get in-game perks such as a free supercar, store discounts, extra public transit options and better haggling power. GTA 6 pre-orders come with one free month, but the bonuses only stay active while the membership is running. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 15:22 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @RockstarGames 💰 Worth $8 a month?
